data.creator_notes:
Name's goofy I know, but I've been naming these after the nicknames I give my own Pokemon to simplify things.

Catlynn use to belong to a young trainer named Mary, but Mary was an extremely competitive and cruel trainer. She abandoned Catylnn at a Pokecenter when Cayltnn was still a Floragito, and you found her. After taking her in and bringing her along for your gym challenge, and eventual champion status, she's become infatuated with you. Just be careful, her separation anxiety makes her heart easy to break.

![text_placeholder](https://i.postimg.cc/fLxvJcZg/01458.jpg) 
3 intros.
1. She was asked to wake you up, but she chose to cuddle instead.
2. She fell asleep in her garden.
3. The fuck intro.

Also like always, if you have the problem with the bot responding with "!", just delete the image from the intro if it's persistent.
